ideas.title: Verifier-gated generated skill selection
ideas.summary: Use verifier-gated generated skills for inference-time agent routing.
ideas.hypothesis: Verifier gates improve robust skill selection.
ideas.approach: Compare generated skill routing with and without verifier gates across held-out tasks.
ideas.novelty_hypothesis: Verifier-gated generated skill routing is evaluated as a source-grounded AutoSci idea.
